capabilities: Mark glossary terms wherever they appear in notes
Add a term to the glossary from the command palette
Open the glossary entry from a marked term
extras: Works on desktop and mobile; makes no network requests and writes only to the glossary note and its own settings file.
problem: Definitions kept in a separate glossary note are invisible while reading or editing other notes, so unfamiliar terms force you to leave the note to look them up.
summary: Reads a glossary note and marks its terms across your notes, showing the definition in a tooltip on hover.
